markdownRemark.html:
Upright Medical came to us with a messy website and no real system for tracking leads. They wanted a modern look and a smoother onboarding process.

The Challenge

Their team was juggling outdated forms, slow page loads, and little-to-no SEO. New patients struggled to get the info they needed.

The GrowLab Approach

We implemented the Founder Bundle, starting with a fresh design and automated intake workflows. The site now captures leads automatically and syncs them with their CRM.

Results

  • 40% more website inquiries in the first month
  • Faster turnaround on patient onboarding
  • Better search rankings thanks to our SEO Content Pack

Key Takeaway

A polished site and automated workflows let the Upright team focus on patient care instead of paperwork.

You've Got This

Whether you're in healthcare or SaaS, smart automation and a clean design can transform your business in weeks, not months.

faqs.question: Did Upright Medical start from scratch?
faqs.answer: No, we migrated their old site and improved it in stages.

faqs.question: How long did the project take?
faqs.answer: Everything launched in about two weeks.

faqs.question: Can I implement just one part of the bundle?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Each tool works on its own, or you can combine them.
